title: Summoning Rune Ritual
description: A dark crystalline monolith rises from the center of an intricate glowing rune circle on the stone floor of a ruined circular chamber. Glowing magical energy in purple and white swirls upward from the monolith as green ethereal lines connect to scattered artifacts and broken stone tablets, with ancient Nordic-style runes carved into the surrounding walls under a starry night sky visible through the arches.
prompt: A dark jagged crystalline monolith stands at the center of a large circular magical rune on the floor of an ancient ruined stone chamber with arched openings, glowing purple and white magical energy swirls upward from the monolith forming ethereal patterns, bright green ley lines connect the circle to scattered stone tablets and artifacts on the ground, ancient Nordic runes carved into the weathered walls, dramatic lighting with magical glow illuminating the scene, night sky with aurora visible through the arches, detailed fantasy illustration
